environment.description: Container deployed on GKE Autopilot with the following pod security context: the entire rootfs is mounted read-only via `readOnlyRootFilesystem: true` in the securityContext, and NO volume mounts, emptyDir, or tmpfs volumes are defined in the pod spec. The container uses musl-based static binary (alpine base). Additionally, the node pool runs with COS_CONTAINERD image which enforces dm-verity on the root partition. The Kubernetes SecurityContext also sets `allowPrivilegeEscalation: false` and drops ALL capabilities.
